Job title:

Product Manager

G&B Digital Products, PHDSI

Your role:

The Product Manager will be responsible for driving the product management activities for digital propositions within Grooming & Beauty, with an initial focus on the Lumea program. The role will work closely with Business, R&D, Digital, UX, Data/AI, Marketing, Regions and Platform teams to ensure strong product definition, roadmap alignment, business value realization and successful delivery of digital experiences.

responsibilities: Own and drive Product Management activities for assigned G&B digital propositions, ensuring alignment with business strategy, consumer needs, market priorities and portfolio direction.

Lead cross-functional alignment across Business, PHDSI, R&D, UX, Marketing, Regions, Quality, Regulatory and Platform teams to ensure effective decision-making and execution.

Track product performance after launch using relevant KPIs such as adoption, engagement, consumer feedback, funnel performance, service impact and business value.
Identify opportunities to strengthen platform reuse, digital infrastructure alignment and common capabilities across G&B, while allowing for category-specific differentiation where needed.
Ensure adherence to Philips product development, quality, privacy, security, regulatory and lifecycle management processes.

Want to be part of our story? Apply today!

Senior Product Manager, Search, Indexing and Query

Couchbase | Product Organisation | Bangalore, India | Reports to VP of AI Product Management
responsibilities: Couchbase is building the operational data platform for AI. Search, indexing and query are the core of it — how data is found, filtered, ranked and returned is what determines whether an application, or an agent, can actually use the data underneath. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own that surface area across Capella and Couchbase Enterprise: the SQL++ query experience, secondary indexing, full-text search, and vector and hybrid search.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to do the work at the Senior level — write the PRFAQ, sit with the customer, push the tradeoff, ship the capability, and own the outcome after launch. Reporting to the VP of AI Product Management, you will partner closely with the query, indexing and search engineering teams, with sales and GTM, and with the broader AI organization.
You do not need to have shipped a query engine or a search product before. We are hiring for the underlying capability, not the resume line — see “Who This Role Is Open To” below.
What You Will Own

Search, indexing and query as a product surface: End-to-end ownership of how customers express and satisfy a query on Couchbase — SQL++ query, global secondary indexes, full-text search, and vector and hybrid search. The roadmap in your area, the PRFAQs and PRDs, the launch, the adoption, and the iteration after launch.

Retrieval for AI applications: Make Couchbase the retrieval layer that RAG applications and agents actually use — hybrid search relevance, metadata filtering, recall and freshness, and cost per query. Work with the wider AI portfolio so retrieval composes with the rest of the platform rather than sitting beside it.

Developer experience for query and indexing: How a developer writes a query, gets an index recommendation, debugs a slow plan, and understands what a query costs. Reduce the number of things a developer has to know before their first query is fast.

Performance, cost and benchmark credibility: Own the performance story for your area. Reproducible benchmarks the field can stand behind, a defensible cost and TCO narrative against MongoDB, Elastic, Postgres and pgvector, and dedicated vector stores, and a clear point of view on where Couchbase wins and where it does not.

Working backwards from the customer: Start with the customer and work backwards. Write the PRFAQ before any code is written. Validate with real, named enterprise customers. Make clear tradeoff calls about what to build and what to defer based on what the enterprise ICP universally needs — not features chasing competitors or one-off requests outside the ICP.

Engineering partnership: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the query, indexing and search engineering teams. Earn their trust by being technically credible, decisive on scope, and clear on the why. Own the PRD as a living document, not a one-time artifact. Hold the bar on quality, scope, and timing through to launch.

Customer and design partner engagement: Run design partner programs for the capabilities you own. Bring real customer voice into roadmap decisions and back to the broader team. Help build a pipeline of named reference customers willing to talk publicly about what they have shipped.

Cross-portfolio collaboration: Coordinate across Core Database, Capella, Analytics, Mobile and Edge, and the AI Specialist team so the capabilities you own compose cleanly with the rest of the platform. Bring a build-vs-partner point of view to your area.
requirements: Seven or more years in product management, with at least three on a technical platform — database, data infrastructure, search, analytics, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or AI infrastructure.

Systems depth. You can reason about latency, throughput, recall, index structures, query plans, memory and storage tradeoffs, and cost per operation. Given a benchmark or a slow query, you know what to ask next.

Customer obsession and working-backwards rigor: You start with the customer and work backwards. You write PRFAQs before code. You can tell which feature requests reflect universal ICP needs and which are noise, and you make the call clearly.
Engineering credibility: Engineers want to work with you. You hold your own on architecture, are decisive on scope, and own the why behind every tradeoff.
Cross-functional trust: Sales trusts your roadmap. GTM trusts your enablement. Marketing trusts your narrative. You build durable working relationships outside your own team.
AI-driven PM practice: You already use AI in your own PM work — research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis — and you can point to concrete examples.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - API's
jobs.description:
Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together. This position is based at our office in Chennai, India. Appian was built on a culture of in-person collaboration, which we believe is a key driver of our mission to be the best.

You will be the product manager working closely with the team whose mission is re-architecting existing subsystems into modern, API-first components. You will be responsible for the direction and roadmap of several of these components to ensure backward compatibility, reliability, high-performance operations, and extensibility.

This role requires a unique blend of technical curiosity and strategic reasoning: you aren't just managing a backlog; you are analyzing how our systems should be rebuilt to support a future of AI-driven process automation.
responsibilities: System Modernization & API Definition: Partner with engineering to deconstruct existing subsystems and define modern, scalable Application Programming Interfaces (APIs). You will ensure these interfaces are robust, performant, and future-proof.

Comparative Analysis: Evaluate current architectural patterns against industry standards. You will perform trade-off analyses (latency vs. flexibility, cost vs. speed) to determine the optimal path for modernization.
Strategic Alignment (IMP): Use the Impact-Metrics-Plans framework to ensure design decisions map to Appian’s goals for process automation, data fabric capabilities, or AI throughput.
Collaborative Discovery: Work closely with stakeholders in both Chennai and the US to understand how backend changes will impact the development experience for designers using our platform.
Backlog Excellence: Manage the release and sprint backlog through rigorous grooming, writing detailed specifications that leave no room for ambiguity.
Specification Writing: Write detailed specifications for the team and fellow product managers to review and provide feedback on.
Impact Analysis: Track adoption and usage of new features, applying appropriate metrics and analytics to evaluate whether they are having the desired impact.
Ownership: Own features all the way through final documentation, go-to-market, prioritization of bugs, and usage analysis.

jobs.description:
At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.

For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off-the-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.

Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.

Title: Sr Product Manager

Location: Bangalore

Reporting to: VP, Product Management

Department: Product Management
responsibilities: We are building a new product team in India focused on the administration experience: the governance, controls, and platform plumbing that large customers depend on. We have two openings for Senior Product Managers. One will own data synchronization and integration reliability. The other will own governance and application lifecycle management. Both roles are about making Quickbase trustworthy, manageable, and safe at scale.
What You Will Do
Own a core area of the administration domain end to end. Depending on the role, that is either sync and integration reliability, or governance and application lifecycle management.
Turn admin and IT pain into a clear roadmap. Reduce the effort of setting up and running Quickbase at scale.
Partner daily with Engineering and Design to ship reliable, well-governed capabilities.
Stay close to customers and the field. Bring real admin and IT problems into the work every week.
Define and track the metrics that show the platform is easier to govern and administer.
Use AI to move faster, in your research, your specs, and where it helps admins directly.
What Success Looks Like
Administration and governance capabilities that measurably reduce setup and management effort.
Fewer escalations and higher confidence among the IT and admin buyers who gate expansion.
A reliable sync and integration foundation that customers trust with their most important data.
requirements: Required
5 to 9 years in product management, with a track record of owning technical product areas and delivering outcomes.
Deep SaaS product experience, ideally with a PaaS or platform product.
Highly technical. You understand APIs, data models, and how systems integrate, and can go deep with engineering, without being a developer yourself.
Comfort with technical, systems-level products: integrations, data, governance, or platform administration.
You work fluently with leading AI tools and use them daily in your product work.
Strong analytical skills and a habit of deciding from data and direct customer contact.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration.
preferred: Low-code or no-code platform experience is a bonus.
Some design ability, and comfort prototyping your own ideas with tools like Figma, Figma Make, or Claude Design.
Familiarity with governance, security, compliance, or IT administration.
Experience with integration or data-synchronization products.
How You Work
Detail-oriented and reliability-minded.
Customer-obsessed, in front of admins and IT buyers regularly.
Pragmatic operator who ships and iterates.

jobs.description: The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
responsibilities: Aspen Technology, a business unit inside Emerson Corporation, is a leading industrial software company, serving over 3,000 customers with over $1 billion in annual revenue, more than 60 locations worldwide, and nearly 4,000 employees. AspenTech solutions address complex environments where it is critical to optimize the asset design, operation and maintenance lifecycle.

Through AspenTech’s unique combination of deep domain expertise and award-winning innovative software suites, customers in asset-intensive industries can improve their operational excellence while achieving sustainability goals.

The AspenTech Performance Engineering Solution provides a market leading integrated suite of products to optimize the performance of process industry assets across the CAPEX and OPEX cycles and is powered by flagship process modeling products with a proven track record of value creation over several decades.

Aspen Exchanger Design & Rating (EDR) is a comprehensive heat exchanger modeling and design suite that helps process engineers and equipment manufacturers optimize thermal equipment performance across the asset lifecycle. It delivers customer value through improved engineering productivity, reduced project risk, and lower CAPEX/OPEX via accurate, integrated equipment design and analysis.

We are seeking an experienced and highly analytical Product Manager to lead the strategy and evolution of our Aspen Exchanger Design and Rating (EDR). In this role, you will define the roadmap for industry-leading equipment design software used by process engineers and equipment manufacturers globally. You will work at the intersection of complex thermodynamic modeling and modern software development, ensuring our heat exchanger and equipment design solutions integrate seamlessly with broader process simulation workflows (such as Aspen Plus and Aspen HYSYS) while delivering exceptional user experience.
Product Vision, Strategy, and Sharp Execution
Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for the product, backed by financial assessment such as a business case

Responsible for Agile roadmap for the product lifecycle (ideation and formation through execution), specifying the positioning, pricing, differentiation, competitive strategy, and definable value and proof points
Aligns the product vision and strategy to overall Performance Engineering and AspenTech objectives
Monitor industry trends, competitive developments, and customer requirements.
Customer Engagement and Customer Centricity
Build strong relationships with key customers, industry leaders, and strategic partners.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. MBA a plus.
10+ years of experience in enterprise software Product Management, ideally within engineering, simulation, or industrial software domains.
Strong foundational understanding of process engineering, heat transfer, thermodynamics, or equipment design.
Experience developing product strategies, business cases, and growth plans for enterprise software products
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate across functions and organizational levels.
Product Management experience within industrial software, engineering software or process industries.
Knowledge of Agile product development methodologies.
Prior hands-on experience using Aspen EDR, HTRI, and/or other process simulation and heat exchanger rating tools.
Execution Focus: Knows how to get things done but also has the grit and resilience to drive execution. Pays close attention to detail, and monitors progress well

Outcome Orientation: This individual will be energized by a challenge and will strive to achieve significant outcomes. Demonstrated ability to successfully introduce new products/services to market that is timely, cost-effective, and fully meets the needs of the target segment

Strategic Orientation: The successful candidate will be able to clearly identify and articulate evolving priorities for the business and frame business strategies and strategic direction for his/her area of business, underpinned by intensive market analysis, immediate customer feedback, and competitive analysis to drive solution development.

Sr. Director Product Management

At Capital One, we think big and do bigger things. We were the first company to develop and offer mass customization and personalization of credit card, auto loans and other financial services products, and we have been innovating relentlessly ever since. Today, we are a progressive financial services powerhouse spanning Credit Cards, Auto Loans, Savings, and Commercial Banking and at the same time a high tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a well recognized brand all in one. We are a passionate and entrepreneurial team with heart, a team that embraces bold ideas, fosters collaboration, and delivers world class products and services impacting over 65 million customer accounts.

Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other. Our goal is simple – bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change.

Team Description:

Capital One Software is a new line of business within Capital One that provides software to allow regulated Enterprises to unleash data to safely empower innovation. Capital One Software launched Slingshot, an AI assisted Data warehouse optimization product and Databolt, a data management and protection platform with many more innovations still in progress. Customers want to enable safe use of proprietary data to allow agents and AI models
responsibilities: Capital One Software in India is looking for senior product leadership to spearhead our foray into the next generation of Capital One Software in an AI native world. This role involves working backwards from customers, working with product leaders to define the precise problem we are solving, and leading Engineering teams to build impactful products that delight customers. The role encompasses recruiting, developing, and motivating an exceptional team that is drawn from elite campuses in India and abroad, and focused on our mission to develop world class data products.
Human Centered
You’ll deeply immerse yourself in knowing your internal and/or external customer(s) needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions.
You’ll be challenged to discover customer needs and inspire innovative solutions or products in light of industry trends, emerging technologies and business and customer insights.
Business Focused

You’ll be the leader to develop a compelling portfolio or product vision for our organization to deliver capabilities that empower differentiated customer experiences and deliver breakthrough business value.
You’ll lead a team that translates vision into strategic product roadmaps with an agile delivery approach in partnership with Tech while managing cyber, operational and/or regulatory risks.
Technology Driven

You’ll partner with Technology leaders to influence end state architecture and drive secure, resilient, performant and scalable technology solutions that solve material customer and business problems.

You’ll be responsible for making technology investments decisions by assessing opportunities for reusing Enterprise solutions or for and building new ones with extensibility & enterprise scalability in mind.
Transformational Leadership
You’ll influence a broad set of senior executives across the enterprise and your organization who are stakeholders or delivery partners to successfully deliver on your portfolio/product vision.
requirements: Intellectually Curious: You’re comfortable navigating between the big ideas and executional realities to create an achievable strategic product vision. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges.

A Strong Communicator & Influencer: You’re comfortable influencing a group of executives as well as communicating your product vision clearly to your associates and partners. You can be open to different communication styles and listen carefully to diverse sets of ideas.

A Do-er with Action Oriented: You’re biased toward action, and are willing to make commitments and trade offs with other leaders to remove impediments for your team; you are a leader obsessed with delivering valuable in an iterative way focusing on minimum viable product.

Passionate & Customer Focused: You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs and build long lasting relationships.

Growth Mindset: You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when exploring unknown technologies; you will seek for internal solutions before building new ones.
A Team Player: You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You are also able to coach others and be a mentor in product development.
Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Develop and communicate the product vision and strategy for your area of responsibility.
Partner with business and technology leadership to align on prioritization of key problems to be solved to maximize business and customer outcomes.
Collaborate with teams in India and USA to drive alignment with different teams working on the platform.
Incorporate design thinking and analytics to inform product design.
Responsible for a team of directly reporting product managers.

Overview

Come join the QuickBooks Desktop team (part of Mid-Market Segment) as a Senior Staff Product Manager, AI Migration & Onboarding Agent.

QuickBooks is Intuit's flagship accounting software, powering millions of small and mid-sized businesses globally. The Mid-Market team is driving a critical transformation: migrating customers from Desktop to cloud-native platforms.

Today, migration from desktop to cloud is high-friction and high-touch. It slows conversion and strains support capacity. Your mission is to change that by building an AI Agent that guides customers through the entire migration journey, from readiness assessment to data migration, configuration, and first productive use.

This is a zero-to-one role. You will own the vision, strategy, and execution for this agent, working at the intersection of LLMs, agentic architectures, and accounting domain knowledge to turn migration from a barrier into a growth engine.
responsibilities: Own the AI Migration Agent end-to-end: Define vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI agent that guides customers through complex product migrations, from readiness assessment through post-migration validation.
Design for scalability and reuse: Architect the agent as a modular platform capability that can be extended to multiple source systems, customer segments, and net-new onboarding journeys.
Define AI/Human collaboration: Design patterns where the agent handles routine tasks autonomously and escalates complex decisions to domain experts, support teams, or customers.
Build the knowledge backbone: Own the agent's knowledge base, including product mapping logic, feature parity data, gap analysis rules, and domain-specific reasoning.
Drive adoption and migration velocity: Define success metrics (completion rate, time-to-value, CSAT, support deflection) and build feedback loops to continuously improve agent performance.

Lead cross-functional execution: Align engineering, AI/ML, design, data science, sales, care, and operations around an agent-first migration strategy. Partner with platform teams to leverage shared AI infrastructure.
Close the customer insight loop: Research migrating customers, domain experts, and internal teams to uncover friction points and benchmark against AI-driven migration experiences in SaaS and Fintech.
requirements: Experience: 10+ years in product management with 2+ years shipping AI agent, conversational AI, or intelligent automation products in B2B SaaS or Fintech.

AI Agent expertise: Deep understanding of agentic architectures, LLMs, RAG systems, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation pipelines. Experience defining guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human-in-the-loop escalation patterns.

B2B SaaS Migration experience: Track record building customer migration, data portability, or onboarding products. Understands the complexity of moving business-critical data between systems at scale.
Platform thinking: Designs modular, reusable agent capabilities that serve multiple source systems, customer segments, and journey types.
Customer empathy: Deep experience with SMB/mid-market customers. Understands the friction and anxiety customers face when switching business-critical software.
Analytical rigor: Comfortable defining and tracking agent performance metrics like accuracy, task completion, escalation rate, and time-to-value.
Cross-functional influence: Proven ability to align engineering, AI/ML, design, and GTM teams around a shared product vision in a matrixed organization.

Corporate Planning & Management (CPM) is a central strategic function at Goldman Sachs, responsible for driving firmwide operational excellence, business planning, and the infrastructure that enables the firm to operate with strength, resiliency, and agility. CPM partners across every division deliver scalable solutions, optimize business processes, and position the firm for sustainable growth. The CPM Division unifies Finance & Planning, Spend Management, Operational Risk and Resilience, and CPM Engineering teams to deliver business planning and analytics, expense management, third-party risk management, and governance strategies across the firm. Within Spend Management, the Source to Pay function encompasses Strategic Sourcing, Procure to Pay, Integrated Travel and Expense, Infrastructure and Transformation, and Sustainable Operations — managing all aspects of the firm's spend with third parties, advising on commercial agreements, and driving operating efficiency.
SOURCE TO PAY –PRODUCT MANAGEMENT

Within CPM, the Source to Pay function oversees the end-to-end lifecycle of procurement and payables — from sourcing and vendor management through purchasing, invoicing, and payment. The Global Procurement team is focused on optimizing the procurement experience for internal firmwide stakeholders, Goldman Sachs suppliers, and Global Procurement operations teams — driving customer experience excellence, enabling frictionless interactions across the procurement lifecycle, and delivering scalable solutions anchored in the SAP Ariba platform ecosystem.

Professionals in CPM have an analytical mindset, exhibit intellectual curiosity, and come from diverse academic backgrounds. The ideal candidate brings solid experience in product management and a growing understanding of procurement business processes and customer experience design — with hands-on familiarity with SAP Ariba or comparable Source to Pay platforms. This role requires close partnership across Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Tax, and global Source to Pay teams, with the ability to translate business needs into practical platform solutions. Director of Product

AI Cloud and Orchestration, Velocis Platform

Reports to Chief Product Officer

Location Mumbai

Function Product Leadership, AI Infrastructure (Velocis)

Why this role, why now?

Neysa is building the AI cloud for the era where AI runs in production rather than in pilots. The promise we are claiming to deliver is operational confidence, the ability for an enterprise to run AI predictably, affordably and accountably. Infrastructure choices now decide which AI programmes are viable at all, and for us sovereignty means strategic control rather than a compliance checkbox.

Velocis is how we deliver that, across GPU as a service and our AI platform as a service. We are scaling from strong early proof into a platform that serves sovereign enterprise buyers in India and large offtake capacity globally. This role exists to help set product direction and to make it real.
responsibilities: We are hiring a Senior Director of Product to sit alongside the Chief Product Officer as a balanced strategist and operator, and to co-own the Velocis product ecosystem. You will help shape the two-year product strategy and you will own the roadmap, prioritisation and specification sign-off that turn it into shipped platform. Engineering, infrastructure operations, design and go-to-market are your delivery partners, and product holds the pen on what gets built and in what order.
You will move between whiteboarding high-density cluster architecture with an executive buyer in one hour and running a deep specification review with a product manager in the next. Both are the job.
What you will own?Product strategy and roadmap
Co-own the 12 and 24 month strategy for Velocis across GPU as a service and the AI platform, and hold the roadmap, prioritisation and specification sign-off end to end.
Ship the Velocis AI platform stack and move straight into post-launch feature velocity, reliability, and the Day-0 and Day-1 user journey.
Keep a live read on the global AI infrastructure landscape, across orchestration layers, sovereign cloud, inference economics and power and density, so Velocis holds its edge.
Team and craft
Lead, mentor and hold accountable a team of four or more product managers across the core Velocis modules.
Build a product culture of extreme ownership, technical precision and fast feedback, and raise the hiring bar as the team grows.
Coach high-potential talent and step in where a track needs lift.
Enterprise commercials and offtake
Partner with the CPO and CEO on offtake opportunities from 1,000 to 8,000 GPUs, shaping orchestration specs, tenant isolation and SLA commitments.
requirements: Ten or more years in product management, with four or more leading product teams. Hands-on experience in GPU computing, AI or ML orchestration or HPC is ideal, and strong candidates from adjacent large-scale cloud or general-purpose cloud infrastructure, with the ability to ramp fast, will be considered.
A track record of shipping complex B2B infrastructure products from concept to meaningful revenue scale.

Fluency across GPU infrastructure on NVIDIA and AMD, container and workload orchestration such as Kubernetes, Slurm and Ray, VPC and network topologies, object storage and dedicated inference pipelines.

Working command of multi-tenancy and tenant isolation, observability and cost attribution, sovereign deployment patterns such as air-gapped clusters and customer-managed keys, and inference economics measured as cost per token and P99 latency.
Commercial fluency, so that you connect product decisions to gross margin, resource efficiency and customer return.
How you work?
You zoom out to market positioning and a two-year horizon, and zoom in to specifications, telemetry and the granular detail, without losing either.
You have a default to action and high standards, and you pair them with the judgment to say no and to sequence well.
You are a low-ego and articulate communicator who earns credibility quickly with engineers, enterprise CTOs and executive leadership.
You are comfortable building in a category that is still being created.

Take full ownership of the roadmap and prioritisation across the PM tracks, with clear ownership lines in place.

More about our mission and what we offer.

Principal Product Manager, APAC Payments Scheme Integrations

Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. We need someone to help us move money seamlessly in APAC.

We process hundreds of millions of payments for our customers per year. When Wise started we used banks to power our payments. But as we’ve grown we’ve started connecting directly to national payment schemes such as Australia’s NPP, Singapore’s FAST, Philippines' InstaPay, and Japan’s Zengin.

Drive operational excellence: Identify and implement improvements to enhance the performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency of the scheme integration.

Clear, concise communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on authority.
preferred: Experience working with payment scheme integrations

jobs.description:
ABOUT DBMCI ONE

DBMCI One is a learning platform for medical students and doctors, a product of NHPL (Neuroglia Health Private Limited), a subsidiary of M3, Inc., Japan's largest healthcare company, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

NHPL is also the company behind Marrow, India's largest and most trusted learning platform for NEET PG preparation.

DBMCI One brings together the legacy of Dr. Bhatia's Medical Coaching Institute, trusted by generations of medical aspirants, with the product velocity and data discipline of a modern tech company. We are building the definitive learning platform for India's next generation of doctors: one that adapts to how each aspirant learns, making the journey from preparation to practice measurably better.

The stakes are real. The ambition is bigger.
responsibilities: We are looking for a Product Manager to own the learner growth and engagement charter at DBMCI One. This is not a coordination role. It is a high-ownership position where you define what keeps a medical student coming back every day, what drives them from trial to deep engagement, and what ultimately makes them succeed.

You are joining at an inflection point. The habits and learning outcomes you shape today will determine how thousands of medical students learn, and in turn, how they diagnose, treat, and care for millions of patients tomorrow.
You will work hand-in-hand with Engineering, Design, Content, Data, and Marketing to ship a product that moves real numbers and real lives.
AI is not a tool you will be asked to explore here. It is the default. You are expected to prototype, automate, and iterate using AI natively from day one.
WHAT YOU'LL OWN
Own the full growth loop: Activation Engagement Habit Formation Retention for DBMCI One learners across platforms.
Define and drive the product roadmap for learner-facing features, from discovery through experimentation, launch, and post-launch iteration.
Use AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools to independently build and test product ideas, reducing dependence on full engineering cycles for early validation.
Design and run GTM experiments: scope the hypothesis, build a lean version, get it in front of real users, gather feedback, and iterate fast before committing to a full build.
Design and run A/B experiments at pace. Test hypotheses, kill what does not work, and double down on what does.
Conduct structured user research: interviews, session analysis, and cohort studies to uncover the real reasons learners drop off or stay hooked.
Identify leading indicators of learner success and build features that move them, not vanity metrics.
requirements: 2 to 4 years of Product Management experience at a tech-first company. Consumer internet, EdTech, or mobile-first products are strongly preferred.
Strong product thinking grounded in user behaviour. You can articulate the "why behind the why" for any user action or drop-off.
Hands-on data fluency: SQL, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and A/B experiment design. You live in data, not just talk about it.

AI fluency is non-negotiable. Proficient with AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools (Cursor, Bolt, Lovable, Replit, or similar). Practical experience with agentic AI workflows, automation, and prompt engineering applied to product work.
Technical fluency: You can hold a system design conversation with Engineering, understand API dependencies, and make informed build-vs-scope decisions.
Proven ability to run end-to-end GTM experiments: scope, build, launch, gather user feedback, and iterate with speed and structure.
First-principles thinker. You do not copy-paste frameworks; you reason from the user and the context up.
High ownership, low excuses. You move fast, learn faster, and take full responsibility for what ships and what it achieves.
Clear, structured communicator. You can align a cross-functional team with a well-framed problem statement and a sharp point of view.

isha.patnaik@dbmi.edu.in

About Refold AI

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.
responsibilities: Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?

You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours? You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.
requirements: You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.

You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
You write, not deck. Specs, trade-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made
Experience
5+ years in product in the B2B software industry
At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
Degree from a top-tier institution, or hands-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Amazon Pharmacy
jobs.description:
Description

Join Amazon Pharmacy's Supply Chain team and shape the systems that determine how medications reach patients. You will define product strategy and drive performance for the buying and inventory planning systems at the core of the pharmacy supply chain: procurement systems that decide what to buy and when under expiry and regulatory constraints, inventory planning that sets optimal stock levels across the network, and placement algorithms that position inventory across fulfillment centers. These systems are informed by demand forecasts that predict prescription volume, but your focus is turning that signal into smart purchasing and inventory decisions.

Pharmacy supply chains are unlike retail: demand is primarily driven by prescriptions (not browsing), products expire, controlled substances require compliance layers, and regulations vary by state. Every buying and inventory decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.

We are looking for a dynamic, analytically rigorous Senior Product Manager
responsibilities: Tech to own the product strategy for how Amazon Pharmacy determines optimal inventory levels, decides what and when to buy, simulates network decisions, and identifies unhealthy inventory — with demand forecasting as a key input to those decisions. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across these domains — working directly with engineers and scientists building the underlying optimization and ML systems.

Define the product vision and multi-year roadmap for pharmacy supply chain systems: procurement, inventory placement and capacity planning
Translate complex supply chain and healthcare constraints (expiry, controlled substances, state regulations) into product requirements that engineering teams can build against
Design and own the end-to-end metrics framework for pharmacy supply chain health within your domain
Work with Operations, Compliance, Vendor Management, Fulfillment, Finance, and In-Stock partners to provide solutions and drive improvements
Partner with Applied Scientists and ML Engineers to define success criteria for forecasting models, optimization algorithms, and automated decision systems
Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment

responsibilities: We are looking for a Product Manager to take ownership of the DEX Monitoring and Automations area within TeamViewer ONE. This is a high-impact, highly visible role at the centre of TeamViewer's Autonomous Endpoint Management (AEM) strategy — the journey from reactive IT to fully autonomous endpoint operations.

You will own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for two equally strategic pillars: proactive digital employee experience monitoring (real-time telemetry, DEX scoring, AI-driven insights) and IT workflow automation (the DEX Hub automation library, Tia Scripting, SCALE instructions, and remediation workflows). DEX Monitoring & Insights

Define and execute the product roadmap for real-time DEX telemetry, endpoint health monitoring, and experience scoring, evolving the DEX Score to reflect true user-centric performance during live usage.

Define and track key experience metrics (DEX Score, MTTR, proactive issue resolution rate) and use these to continuously improve platform effectiveness and customer outcomes.
Automations & Workflow Orchestration

Own the vision and roadmap for the TeamViewer DEX Hub automation library — the centralized, single source of truth for OOTB and custom SCALE instructions, automations, and remediation workflows across the organization.

Lead the strategy for Tia Scripting, enabling IT admins to create automations and scripts through natural language — lowering the barrier to automation creation and eliminating dependence on deep PowerShell or Bash expertise.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Job Description

This is a remote position.

Experience Level

We're looking for a seasoned Product Owner with at least 2–4 years of experience owning a product backlog end-to-end within an Agile delivery environment. You should be a "delivery craftsperson" who can demonstrate a track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team requirements into shipped, working software — with particular comfort operating inside platforms where your product's success depends on coordination with teams you don't manage.
responsibilities: As a Product Owner, you will own the backlog and delivery cadence for one product within a tightly interconnected platform, where your product's roadmap depends on — and feeds into — several sibling products. You'll act as the point of alignment between engineering teams, supporting product managers, and client stakeholders, translating business and compliance needs into backlog items ready for a development team to execute against.

A key part of the role is holding the line on requirements quality: defining clear acceptance criteria before work enters a sprint, and sequencing competing demands — new features, maintenance of live services, and production support — that your team carries simultaneously. Because your product does not operate in isolation, a large part of the job is coordinating dependencies across teams that don't report to you.
Backlog Ownership & Requirements Definition: Own and prioritize the product backlog; define acceptance criteria for accuracy, completeness, and readiness before stories are marked sprint-ready.

Cross-Team Dependency Coordination: Sequence and negotiate delivery across multiple dependent engineering teams (platform, integration, infrastructure, and adjacent product teams), since most features require multi-team scheduling rather than single-team execution.

Delivery Prioritization Under Competing Demands: Balance new feature development, maintenance of live production services, and active production support within the same backlog, without letting one silently starve the others.

Domain Ramp-Up: Build working depth in the specific technical and regulatory domain tied to your assigned product — this may include healthcare EDI transaction standards, web-automation/data-extraction reliability, credential and access-security models, or regulated payments and remittance processing, depending on placement.

Stakeholder & Requirements Governance: Partner with the supporting Product Manager and client-side stakeholders to close open requirement decisions before development starts, hold sign-off discipline, and manage rework risk from late-stage scope changes.

Data & Interface Quality Ownership: Where your product's output feeds downstream systems, own the interface contract (field definitions, data completeness, naming) to prevent avoidable rework further down the chain.
requirements: Proven Product Ownership Experience: Track record owning a backlog end-to-end in an Agile environment, ideally within a platform where products are tightly coupled rather than independent.

Domain Adaptability: Comfort ramping quickly into unfamiliar technical or regulatory domains — some assignments require near-immediate fluency (e.g., regulated payments, EDI standards), while others allow for a longer runway.
Cross-Functional Coordination Skills: Demonstrated ability to sequence work and resolve competing priorities across multiple engineering teams that don't report into the same chain.
Analytical Rigor: Ability to write precise, testable acceptance criteria and reason through data quality or completeness gaps before they become delivery blockers.
Strong Stakeholder Communication: Comfortable representing product status and trade-offs to both engineering teams and client-facing stakeholders, in plain, non-technical language when needed.

Judgment Under Ambiguity: Able to recognize when a decision needs escalation versus independent ownership — particularly important for the more regulation-heavy assignments, where working without senior support isn't advisable early on.

responsibilities: Innefu Labs is looking for a Product Manager who has personally taken an agentic AI product from a blank whiteboard to a production system — not someone who has only added AI features to an existing roadmap. You will own the vision, architecture-level tradeoffs, and go-to-market for a multi-agent, LLM-driven product line, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, applied AI, and design to ship autonomous systems that reason, plan, and act with minimal human handholding.

This is a builder's role. You are expected to be technically fluent enough to sit inside architecture discussions on agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation frameworks — and translate that into a roadmap, prioritization model, and business outcome the rest of the company can rally behind.
Location Delhi
5 Days Work from office
What You Will Own
Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for an agentic AI product built from zero — problem discovery, architecture direction, MVP scoping, and scale-up.

Translate ambiguous, open-ended problems into a phased agentic system design: which tasks are agent-driven vs. deterministic, where human-in-the-loop checkpoints belong, and how autonomy expands release over release.

Partner with engineering on core architecture decisions — agent orchestration and planning layers, tool-calling/function-calling design, memory and state management, RAG and retrieval pipelines, and multi-agent coordination patterns.

Own the evaluation framework for agent quality — task success rate, hallucination/error rate, latency, cost-per-task, and safety guardrails — and use it to drive prioritization, not just measure it after the fact.
Define prompt, tool, and knowledge-source specifications working directly with applied AI/ML engineers; review agent behavior transcripts and failure cases as part of the regular product cycle.
Run structured discovery with enterprise customers and internal stakeholders to identify high-value workflows for autonomous or semi-autonomous automation.

Own the build-vs-buy and framework decisions in collaboration with engineering (agent frameworks, vector databases, LLM providers, orchestration layers) and stay current on the fast-moving agentic AI ecosystem.
requirements: 8–12 years in product management, with demonstrable ownership of at least one AI/ML or agentic AI product taken from concept/zero to a live, adopted release — not just a feature add-on to an existing product.

Solid working knowledge of the surrounding AI stack: LLM APIs and fine-tuning/prompting tradeoffs, RAG pipelines, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and evaluation/observability tooling for LLM-based systems.

Familiarity with common agent frameworks and protocols (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI-style orchestration, or equivalent in-house frameworks) and emerging standards such as MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool/agent interoperability.
Track record of writing clear PRDs/specs for ML-driven features, defining success metrics for probabilistic (not just deterministic) systems, and running structured experimentation.

Comfort partnering closely with engineering and applied AI/ML teams on architecture-level tradeoffs — you don't need to write production code, but you need to hold your own in a systems design conversation.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills — able to translate deep technical tradeoffs into business language for leadership, sales, and customers, and vice versa.
Prior experience in enterprise B2B SaaS, security/intelligence, fintech, or another data-sensitive domain is a plus, given Innefu Labs' customer base.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; an MBA or equivalent is a plus but not a substitute for hands-on technical depth.
preferred: Direct experience owning or contributing to a knowledge-graph or retrieval-heavy product (e.g., Neo4j, Qdrant/pgvector or similar vector stores).
Exposure to agent safety/guardrail design — RBAC for agent actions, audit logging, human-in-the-loop escalation design.
Past experience as an engineer, applied scientist, or technical founder before moving into product.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
responsibilities: Agentic Investigation & Reliability Experiences
Sumo Logic is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead how engineers and operators investigate incidents, understand reliability risk, and act on their operational and security telemetry.

The observability category was built around collecting telemetry and giving people tools to navigate it: dashboards, queries, monitors, traces, and alerts. Customer expectations are now shifting. Teams don't just want more dashboards; they want help getting from a signal to a resolution, understanding what's broken, why, what's impacted, and what to do next. As AI agents move into production operations, this role owns how Sumo Logic brings intelligent, agent-assisted investigation and reliability workflows to customers, grounded in evidence, context, and enterprise governance.

This is a senior, high-ownership role. It requires genuine observability domain background. You should have lived in this space and understand how monitoring, troubleshooting, and reliability actually work, combined with the ambition to define a new category of experience on top of it.
What You Will Own
The current data experiences.

Log Search, Live Tail, query and query optimization, Metrics Search, Tracing, Dashboards, and the data-experience UI. This is a live, revenue-generating product with real customers, and keeping it strong is part of the job. You own its health, roadmap, and competitiveness today while steering it toward an AI-native future, focusing new investment where it strengthens investigation, speed, and value for both new and power users.
The reliability and alerting surface.

Monitors, Alerts, SLOs, Scheduled Searches, and the reliability workflows around them. You will own alerting accuracy, noise reduction, and operational health signals both as capabilities customers depend on today and as the foundation for more automated, agent-assisted detection and investigation.
The agentic investigation experience.

You will define how a user moves from a search, a monitor, a dashboard, or an alert to likely cause faster, with supporting evidence. This means productizing investigation workflows that reason across logs, metrics, traces, monitors, dashboards, and related context, and evolving them from reactive troubleshooting toward more proactive detection over time.
What You Will Be Doing
requirements: 8+ years of product management experience with real observability or monitoring domain background. You have owned products in observability, monitoring, incident response, APM, or a closely adjacent operational-telemetry space. This is a hard requirement.

Deep, first-hand understanding of the observability surface area including logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, monitors, alerts, and SLOs, and of how engineers and operators actually investigate incidents and decide what to trust.
Proven ability to run a live, at-scale product, owning the roadmap, health, and competitiveness of shipping surfaces while driving a larger transformation.
A track record of owning broad, technically deep surfaces and setting direction that other teams build on.
Familiarity with how AI and agents are changing data interaction, including natural-language investigation, tools, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop action, or the ability to ramp quickly.

Strong technical instincts around query engines, time-series and trace data, and alerting systems, plus the judgment to know where an AI-assisted experience should replace a manual flow and where depth must stay.
Strong analytical skills and comfort using telemetry, dashboards, SQL, and usage data to understand adoption, friction, reliability, and cost.
Excellent communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write clear proposals, decision docs, PRDs, and acceptance criteria.
High ownership and drive to make progress across a large, ambiguous, fast-moving surface.
Must-Have Qualities
Runs today, builds tomorrow.
Keeps a live product healthy and competitive while reinventing it, and knows what to sustain and what to rebuild.

Monitors, Alerts, SLOs, Scheduled Searches, and the reliability workflows around them. You will own alerting accuracy, noise reduction, and operational health signals both as capabilities customers depend on today and as the foundation for more automated, agent-assisted detection and investigation.
The agentic investigation experience.

You will define how a user moves from a search, a monitor, a dashboard, or an alert to likely cause faster, with supporting evidence. We're building a new product team in India to help shape how customers build, deploy, and operate AI applications on MongoDB. This is an early hire on a growing team—you'll join while the team is still taking shape, with the opportunity to have real impact from the start.

You'll report to a Director of Product Management based in Europe, working async-first with partners across India, EMEA, and North America. The engineering team in India is being built in parallel, so you'll be working closely with engineers from the early days of the team.

We are looking to speak to candidates based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

What you'll own

You'll be the end-to-end owner for a core area of our AI application platform—from discovery and vision through roadmap, delivery, and iteration. This is a senior individual contributor role where you lead through ownership, expertise, and cross-functional influence.
responsibilities: Defining product strategy and roadmap for your area, aligned with MongoDB's broader AI strategy and business goals
Talking to customers — from AI-native startups to large enterprises — to understand how they build and deploy AI applications, where they struggle, and what MongoDB should do about it
Writing clear product narratives, memos, and specs that align stakeholders, clarify trade-offs, to guide conversations with engineering, design, product marketing, etc

Async-first. Documentation and written communication are how decisions travel across time zones
Sync when it makes sense. When we need to discuss something live, we hop on a call to unbundle issues together.

Customer obsession: you're comfortable running discovery calls, digging into workflows, and turning messy feedback into clear product decisions

preferred: Experience building developer tools, AI platforms, or MLOps/LLMOps products
Engineering background or deep experience partnering with engineering on technical products
Experience with enterprise customers on mission-critical workloads
Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Figma Make) to move faster and amplify impact
How we'll measure success (30/60/90 days)

Ramp up on MongoDB products, AI application patterns, and how our teams work

jobs.title: Product Manager
responsibilities: Hevo
The Hard Thing About Data

Most companies that claim to have a "data platform" have a dashboard with some charts and a dream. Hevo has something different. Something that took eight years to build and can't be bought. Over 2,000 companies send us their most sensitive data every single day. 100 billion events a month. Raw. Unfiltered. Before transformation, before aggregation, at the exact moment truth is created. That's not a product feature. That's trust, earned one customer at a time, over eight years, by not screwing up.

That position is now the foundation for something much bigger. We're building an Intelligence Layer on top of it, a system that reads across every data source a company runs, connects the signals that matter, and tells people what to do before they have to go looking for answers. We call it the Context Graph. It's real enough to show results. Early enough that the person who joins now defines what it becomes.
This is the moment. Not the moment after it's obvious. Now.
What You're Walking Into

You'll own a product pod. SaaS integrations, database connectors, or the Intelligence Layer, depending on where the biggest need is when you join. You own the backlog. More importantly, you own the why behind everything that gets built. You report directly to the CEO. In the first 3-6 months, your job is to make the foundation bulletproof, find the gaps in the platform, close them, and make the product sharper than it's ever been. After that, you move into the Intelligence Layer and help define what Hevo becomes in its next chapter.
What This Job Actually Is

Let's be honest about what great PMs do, and what mediocre ones do instead. Mediocre PMs write specs and hand them off. They synthesize feedback from CSMs and call it customer insight. They sit in architecture meetings and nod. They measure their own output in documents shipped, not outcomes delivered. That's not this job. This job is three things, done well, simultneously.

First: technical ownership. You will be in the room when architecture decisions get made. Not watching. Contributing. Pushing back. Asking the questions that change the direction of the decision. You need to understand how data pipelines work at a systems level, CDC, connectors, streaming, schema management, failure modes. If you can't hold your own in that room, engineering will stop inviting you to it. And they'll be right to.

Second: direct customer engagement. You talk to customers yourself. No intermediary. No secondhand summary. You hear the problem in the customer's own words, you sit with the complexity of it, and you own the translation into product decisions. If you're relying on a CSM to tell you what customers need, you will always be one step behind.

Third: making complexity simple. Hevo's product is deeply technical. The people who sell it and support it are not always. A big part of your job is taking complex system behavior and making it crisp and understandable, for Support, for CS, for Solutions Engineering, so they can represent the product confidently to customers. If internal teams are confused, customers will be too.

jobs.description:
EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.

We are seeking a strategic

Product Manager

to lead the governance of Product Master Data, streamline Product Onboarding, and enhance our Product Information Management (PIM) initiatives. You will establish robust data governance policies to ensure consistency, accuracy, and seamless integrations across retail channels. Your role involves designing efficient onboarding processes and collaborating with vendors, IT, and cross-functional teams to ensure smooth data ingestion and integration with ERP, e-commerce, and inventory systems.

#LI-DNI

#EasyApply
responsibilities: Develop and enforce standards for Product Master Data ensuring accuracy and consistency
Optimize product onboarding processes; work with external and internal teams to integrate systems effectively
Elevate product information by enriching descriptions, images, and specifications to support superior customer experiences
Define KPIs, conduct regular data audits, and drive continuous system improvements to ensure scalability
Build compelling business cases to justify data transformation investments and drive innovation
requirements: Proven experience of 12-16 years in managing data transformation projects within the retail industry
Strong technical acumen with a background in data governance
Analytical skills to evaluate data integrity and performance metrics
Experience in cross-functional collaboration across various teams
Proficiency in data management systems and integration tools
Leadership experience in driving product management initiatives
Fluency in English to communicate effectively with stakeholders
We offer
Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons

jobs.description:
EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.

We are currently seeking a

Product Manager
responsibilities: Financial Securities
to join our team.

You will play a crucial role in co-developing a clear product vision, strategy, and roadmap covering the full product development lifecycle. This includes driving new products, and product changes iteratively and continuously, acting as a product owner within an agile team, and ensuring the product is being tested together with clients to gain insights and ensure readiness to launch before market entry. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the transformation of our firm into an agile organization.
#LI-DNI
Technologies
Application Support Securities
Securities Settlement
Americas Securities
Co-develop a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap covering the full product development lifecycle (including creation, version and infrastructure upgrades, and eventual decommissioning)
Drive new products and product changes iteratively and continuously together with cross-functional team members in the pod
Act as product owner within an agile team, participating in agile ceremonies and ensuring the product requirements are clear to designers and engineers
Ensure the product is being tested together with clients to gain insights and ensure readiness to launch before market entry (e.g., UX testing, end user testing and research insights)
requirements: 13-20 years of experience in product management and business analysis
Strong understanding of agile delivery frameworks and product management
Experience of delivery of complex products to clients within the financial industry
Professional expereince as a Product Manager in the financial sector, ideally in the Investment Bank and Securities domain
Experience working with applications supporting Securities settlements & confirmations, preferably US securities settlements through DTCC etc
Experience working with settlement & confirmations business/operations stakeholders, documenting as-is and to-be business & process flows, process engineering etc
Acquaintance with outcome-focused goals, such as using OKRs (Objectives and Key results)
Team player with an enthusiastic and proactive personality, a true agile mindset and strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong active listening and communication skills to build networks and partnerships at all levels
B2+ English level proficiency

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Bluecore is a marketing technology company that’s reimagining how the world’s fastest-growing retail brands transform casual shoppers into lifetime customers. Through our patented retail data model and the recent release of Bluecore Communicate™ and Bluecore Site™, we replace manual processes with an intelligent, AI-driven workflow. We are credited with doubling email revenue, and growing customer retention for more than 400 brands, including Express, Tommy Hilfiger, The North Face, Teleflora, and Bass Pro Shops. We have been recognized as one of the Best Places to Work by Glassdoor and ranked No. 241 on the Inc. 500 List, the most prestigious ranking of the nation’s fastest-growing private companies.

In this role, you will own one of Bluecore’s channels and foster and grow our existing product offering under Bluecore SiteTM. As an enterprise multi-channel personalization platform, Bluecore is an industry leader. You will need to understand how customers drive value from personalization within channels in and out, including general best practices.  This is inherently a cross-functional role -- you will work closely with engineering, design, program management, marketing and sales teams to envision and execute business opportunities.
responsibilities: Articulate the channel strategy and translate this into product requirements and prioritization with our engineers.
Define and prioritize scaling needs as we onboard new customers, grow existing customers, and expand internationally
Manage trade-offs and prioritization between engineering level-of-effort and customer experiences.
Ability to make hypotheses, test with monitoring of data, organize the insights and identify ways to improve efficiency.
requirements: 5+ years as a Product Manager for an enterprise or SaaS software product.
5+ years of experience independently driving and managing complex products within owned marketing channels
Experience coordinating requirements across diverse customer sets.
Customer-centric with a proven track-record of developing and acting on customer insights.
Ability to define opportunities and problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts and make valid conclusions.
Ability to work with cross-functional teams and thrive in a fast-growing, rapidly-changing environment
Experience in MarTech is strongly preferred.
A background in software engineering is a plus.
Knowledge of Agile process and principles

We are proud of the culture of flexibility, inclusivity and trust that we have built around our workforce. We are a remote first organization with the option to potentially work in our New York headquarters on occasion moving forward. We love the opportunity to come together – but employees will always have the option on where they work best.

At Bluecore we believe in encouraging an inclusive environment in which employees feel encouraged to share their unique perspectives, demonstrate their strengths, and act authentically. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, and welcome those from all backgrounds and varying experiences. Bluecore is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fair hiring practices and to building a welcoming environment for all team members. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, familial status or veteran status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
